name: Raidy
source:
A female warrior who controls the power of lightning. She is strong-willed and hates losing, but has a gentle side as well. Constantly in good spirits, when she has a goal in mind she's the type who pursues it straight to the end. Her ultimate attack is the Thunder Slash, and she considers the yellow bandana she wears to be her trademark style. She seeks to discover why she was given her strange power over lightning in the first place...
